Keyword Magic Tool

As an example, if you enter one keyword phrase, Semrush will return thousands of similar keywords that are organized into topics. You can filter it down to questions, ideal for blog posts and FAQs. To look for the keywords that are a little easier for the newer site to rank for, sort them by keyword difficulty.

Impression of each keyword on competitor ranks

Click on Open Organic Research and enter the rival's domain. You'll receive the keywords they rank for, the page they rank for each keyword and the amount of traffic each page receives. Then execute Keyword Gap against two competitors along with your domain. It reveals the keywords they're targeting and the ones that you don't, which is your content strategy for the upcoming month.

Site Audit

Site Audit scans a site like Google does and categorizes the issues into errors, warnings and notices. Then it's time to correct the errors - broken pages, missing title tags, redirect loops are typically the worst offenders. The clean audit also serves as a good product to give to clients.
